propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate implemented control system changes on a retail distribution company's warehouse control system team for four years against the operations specialists' specifications, forty-four changes each on a change record in his name, and tested each change on the emulation rig with a checked test record.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the changes and the tests.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took each change through the software review process with the release approval recorded as the control system lead's, and supported the three distribution centres' support desks through the support queue with the diagnosis split recorded.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the change records and the reference call document the review process, the approval boundary and the support work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the closure notes.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the changes, the tests, the review process, the support work and the closure notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the approval boundary as documented: changes and tests by the candidate, release approval by the control system lead; the packet makes no judgement.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the change system references of the forty-four changes to confirm the assignee field.
